newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ECNZ to pay NZ Govt special div of NZ$158 mln.
newsitem.headline: ECNZ to pay NZ Govt special div of NZ$158 mln.

text.p: Electricity Corporation of New Zealand Ltd (ECNZ) on Monday said it would pay a special dividend of approximately NZ$158 million to the government on March 31, 1997.
"The special dividend is the result of the corporation reviewing its valuation and capital structure," ECNZ said in a statement.
ECNZ said it had now agreed with the government that it will adopt a target gearing ratio of 35 to 40 percent interest bearing debt to 60 to 65 percent equity capital.

"The confirmation of a likely special dividend follows a $655 million revaluation of ECNZ's assets which lifts the corporation's value to $3.275 billion," ECNZ said. The revaluation was announced last week.
Ratings agency Standard and Poor's on Monday announced a cut in ECNZ's ratings to A+ from AA- for long term and to A-1 from A-1+ for short term. The ratings outlook was stable.
"ECNZ is well positioned for the start of the competitive electricity wholesale market on October 1, 1996," ECNZ said.
